steps.title: Open Sign Up
steps.description: Create a new account with email and password, or continue with Google.

steps.title: Fill the short form
steps.description: Add your name, email and a secure password. Your six-digit PIN code is optional.

steps.title: Verify and return
steps.description: Confirm your email when requested. Google sign-up returns you securely to Meenamma.

steps.title: Enter your dashboard
steps.description: After login, your protected dashboard and Daily Kudam become available.
